title: Using a Fact Family to Solve

steps.body: Every unknown so far lives inside one fact family: two parts and a whole. Naming the family turns any unknown into a known fact.
steps.narration: Every unknown so far lives inside one fact family: two parts and a whole. Naming the family turns any unknown into a known fact.

widget.prompt: Use the family 5, 7, 12 on 5 + __ = 12: start at 12 and count back 5. Where do you land?
widget.missFeedback: Start at 12 and count back 5: you land on 7.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 7 — the family fact 12 − 5 = 7 solved the unknown in one step.

predict.prompt: 5 + __ = 12 and 12 − 5 = __ come from the same family. Do they share an answer?
predict.reveal: Both facts rearrange the same three family numbers, so the hidden value is one and the same.
